rationale: The stock gapped up ~12% on earnings but has since pulled back from the session high of $18.34 to $17.32, trading below both VWAP ($17.83) and the 9-EMA ($17.55), placing it in the lower third of today's range — a sign of fading momentum. The earnings news was mixed-to-negative (significant EPS miss, no revenue growth), which undermines a long thesis, while the large gap and elevated relative volume (5.12x) make a short risky against potential residual buying interest. With the spread at 40 bps, the broad market under pressure (SPY -0.79%, VIXY +3.46%), and no clear directional edge, the risk/reward does not justify entry in either direction.
